slug: 2026-01-07 Why Ethiopia, Somalia and Djibouti are starting to matter in digital Africa

facts.fact: TechCabal says Somali mobile money, run by telecoms such as Hormuud and Telesom, processes about 650 million transactions a year, worth about $8 billion or 36% of GDP.
TechCabal says the Central Bank of Somalia launched SIPS and the SOMQR national QR standard in early 2025 to bridge isolated mobile wallets and the banking sector.
TechCabal says the Central Bank of Somalia launched the national Somalia Instant Payment System in early 2025 to link mobile wallets and the banking sector.
